title: Conductor preparation and exact tail-extension specification
statement: For a reduced finite-type rational scheme $X$ [def-trf-smooth-normalized-resolution-rule], define $D_X$ as the normalization conductor [def-trf-conductor-cokernel], and define $P(X)=B_{D_X}(X)$ using [def-trf-normalized-blowup]. Its rational structure map is the composite through $X$. The normal prepared input is $P(X)$ with its normal-domain stalks. The conductor stage count is zero if $D_X$ is unit and one otherwise. For a normalized resolution tower $A$ on $P(X)$ and $B$ on $X$ [def-per-qe-normalized-resolution-rule], the exact extension predicate specifies order embeddings of all levels and centers, each shifted by this count, a length equality, level isomorphisms preserving arrows and extended ideals, and the base equation through $P(X)\to X$ in the unit case. In the nonunit case it specifies the first center as $D_X$ and the first arrow as the conductor normalized blowup. The conductor geometry record stores coherence, nowhere density, unit iff normal, normality and reducedness of $P(X)$, and finite type over the rationals.
